# Load Data and Libraries

```{r}

# Libraries
library(tidyverse)

# Data
field_control <- read_csv("~/Documents/Sports Analytics/2026 CMSAC RRC/field_control_data.csv")
main <- read_csv("~/Documents/Sports Analytics/2026 CMSAC RRC/full_data.csv")

```
# Cleaning

```{r}

# Select play id and pass info to merge with the field control data frame
# Also keep targeted receiver info to understand where the receiver is located at the time of the throw
pass_info <- main %>%
  select(game_id, play_id, frame_id, phase, pass_result, ball_land_x_std, ball_land_y_std, los_x_std,
         player_role, x_std, y_std) %>%
  filter(player_role == "Targeted Receiver", phase == "pre_pass") %>%
  group_by(game_id, play_id) %>%
  filter(frame_id == max(frame_id)) %>%
  ungroup()


```

# WR Location Analysis

```{r}

completed_passes <- pass_info %>%
  filter(pass_result == "C")

library(dplyr)
library(quantreg)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Define independent candidate sequences for X (depth) and Y (width)
tau_x_cand <- seq(0.85, 0.995, by = 0.005)
tau_y_cand <- seq(0.85, 0.995, by = 0.005)

# 2. Pre-compute model predictions to optimize loop performance
preds_x <- map(tau_x_cand, ~ pmax(predict(rq(err_x ~ receiver_depth, tau = .x, data = completed_pass_bounds)), 0.1))
names(preds_x) <- as.character(tau_x_cand)

preds_y <- map(tau_y_cand, ~ pmax(predict(rq(err_y ~ receiver_depth, tau = .x, data = completed_pass_bounds)), 0.1))
names(preds_y) <- as.character(tau_y_cand)

# 3. Evaluate all (tau_x, tau_y) pairs
tau_grid <- expand_grid(tau_x = tau_x_cand, tau_y = tau_y_cand)

eval_grid <- map2_dfr(tau_grid$tau_x, tau_grid$tau_y, function(tx, ty) {
  rx <- preds_x[[as.character(tx)]]
  ry <- preds_y[[as.character(ty)]]
  
  in_ellipse <- ((completed_pass_bounds$err_x / rx)^2 + (completed_pass_bounds$err_y / ry)^2) <= 1.0
  area <- pi * rx * ry
  
  tibble(
    tau_x = tx,
    tau_y = ty,
    actual_coverage = mean(in_ellipse),
    avg_area_sq_yds = mean(area)
  )
})

# 4. Extract true non-dominated Pareto frontier points
pareto_frontier <- eval_grid %>%
  arrange(avg_area_sq_yds) %>%
  mutate(max_cov_so_far = cummax(actual_coverage)) %>%
  filter(actual_coverage == max_cov_so_far) %>%
  distinct(actual_coverage, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    d_cov = actual_coverage - lag(actual_coverage),
    d_area = avg_area_sq_yds - lag(avg_area_sq_yds),
    efficiency = d_cov / d_area
  )

# 5. Plot Pareto frontier with all 2D evaluated pairs
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = eval_grid, aes(x = avg_area_sq_yds, y = actual_coverage), color = "grey80", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = pareto_frontier, aes(x = avg_area_sq_yds, y = actual_coverage), color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = pareto_frontier, aes(x = avg_area_sq_yds, y = actual_coverage, color = tau_x), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    title = "True 2D Pareto Frontier: Independent (tau_x, tau_y) Grid Search",
    x = "Average Ellipse Area (sq yards)",
    y = "Actual Completed Passes Captured (%)",
    color = "tau_x"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# 6. Display optimal combinations ranked by efficiency
pareto_frontier %>%
  filter(!is.na(efficiency)) %>%
  arrange(desc(efficiency)) %>%
  select(tau_x, tau_y, actual_coverage, avg_area_sq_yds, efficiency)

# Find the most efficient tau_x / tau_y pair that captures at least 90% of completions
best_gated_tau <- pareto_frontier %>%
  filter(actual_coverage >= 0.90) %>%
  arrange(desc(efficiency)) %>%
  slice(1)

print(best_gated_tau)

```

# Final Coefficients

```{r}

# Final production quantile regressions
qr_x_final <- rq(err_x ~ receiver_depth, tau = 0.945, data = completed_pass_bounds)
qr_y_final <- rq(err_y ~ receiver_depth, tau = 0.990, data = completed_pass_bounds)

# Print final semi-axes equations
coef(qr_x_final)
coef(qr_y_final)

```

# Plot

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(quantreg)
library(tidyr)

# 1. Fit production quantile regressions at chosen optimal taus
qr_x_final <- rq(err_x ~ receiver_depth, tau = 0.945, data = completed_pass_bounds)
qr_y_final <- rq(err_y ~ receiver_depth, tau = 0.990, data = completed_pass_bounds)

# 2. Sample 9 distinct plays and calculate dynamic semi-axes (R_x, R_y)
set.seed(42) # Set seed for reproducible sample selection
sample_plays <- completed_pass_bounds %>%
  distinct(game_id, play_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 9) %>%
  mutate(
    play_label = paste0("Game: ", game_id, " | Play: ", play_id),
    r_x = pmax(predict(qr_x_final, newdata = .), 0.1),
    r_y = pmax(predict(qr_y_final, newdata = .), 0.1)
  )

# 3. Generate 360-degree boundary ellipse coordinates for each play
theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 100)

ellipse_points <- sample_plays %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(
    play_label = play_label,
    ellipse_x = x_std + r_x * cos(theta),
    ellipse_y = y_std + r_y * sin(theta)
  )

# 4. Generate 3x3 faceted plot
ggplot() +
  # Line of Scrimmage (LOS)
  geom_vline(
    data = sample_plays, 
    aes(xintercept = los_x_std, linetype = "Line of Scrimmage"), 
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  # Dynamic Elliptical Throw Boundary Zone
  geom_polygon(
    data = ellipse_points, 
    aes(x = ellipse_x, y = ellipse_y, group = play_label, fill = "Throw Boundary Zone"), 
    color = "#2563eb", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  # Targeted Receiver Location
  geom_point(
    data = sample_plays, 
    aes(x = x_std, y = y_std, color = "Targeted Receiver"), 
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  # Ball Landing Location
  geom_point(
    data = sample_plays, 
    aes(x = ball_land_x_std, y = ball_land_y_std, color = "Ball Landing Spot"), 
    shape = 4, size = 3.5, stroke = 1.5
  ) +
  # Aesthetics and Styling
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Key Locations",
    values = c("Targeted Receiver" = "#16a34a", "Ball Landing Spot" = "#dc2626")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Boundary Area",
    values = c("Throw Boundary Zone" = "#3b82f6")
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "Field Markers",
    values = c("Line of Scrimmage" = "dashed")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ play_label, ncol = 3) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey80", fill = NA)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Targeted Throw Bounds Across 9 Sampled Plays",
    subtitle = expression(paste("Elliptical boundaries scaled by receiver depth (", tau[x] == 0.945, ", ", tau[y] == 0.990, ")")),
    x = "Field X (Standardized Yards)",
    y = "Field Y (Standardized Yards)"
  )

```
